rationale: Class (a) tightening: the security reviewer is right that a pull_request-triggered job posting ai-sdlc/attestation and the DEC-0065 APPROVE review lets same-repo PR code forge both. Keep the verifier folded (one build, AC1's load goal) but post the status and APPROVE from a small base-defined workflow_run job that executes no PR code. AC1's 'one trigger' wording yields to the trust chain; the task notes the deviation in the PR body. drop-approve and accept-as-is loosen a control and would need a weakening record the operator has not given.
